title: Rural Home Loans Rate Sheet — Terms, Note Rates and Rate Discounts
content:
Rural Home Loans rate sheet: the term, fixed period, note rate before discounts, interest convention and the closing rate discounts of each Country Home product.

## Terms defined

- **Amortization** — months over which the loan amortizes.
- **Fixed period** — months the note rate is fixed from the first payment; equal to the amortization for fixed products.
- **Initial rate** — note rate before discounts under the current rate sheet, annual percent.
- **Interest convention** — the 30-360 monthly convention: each monthly period's interest is the principal multiplied by the annual rate and divided by 12, regardless of days.
- **Autopay discount** — discount when monthly payments are debited automatically from closing, percentage points.
- **Relationship discount** — discount when the member also holds a Farm Real Estate loan in active status at closing, percentage points.
- **Discount cap** — most the discounts may take off together, percentage points.

## Rate sheet

| Product | Amortization (months) | Fixed period (months) | Initial rate (annual percent) | Interest convention |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Country Home 15-Year Fixed | 180 | 180 | 5.875 | 30-360 monthly |
| Country Home 20-Year Fixed | 240 | 240 | 6.125 | 30-360 monthly |
| Country Home 30-Year Fixed | 360 | 360 | 6.375 | 30-360 monthly |
| Country Home 5/6 Adjustable | 360 | 60 | 5.75 | 30-360 monthly |
| Country Home 7/6 Adjustable | 360 | 84 | 5.99 | 30-360 monthly |
| Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 360 | 360 | 6.625 | 30-360 monthly |

## Closing rate discounts

| Product | Autopay discount (points) | Relationship discount (points) | Discount cap (points) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Country Home 15-Year Fixed | 0.125 | 0.125 | 0.25 |
| Country Home 20-Year Fixed | 0.125 | 0.125 | 0.25 |
| Country Home 30-Year Fixed | 0.125 | 0.125 | 0.25 |
| Country Home 5/6 Adjustable | 0.125 | 0.125 | 0.25 |
| Country Home 7/6 Adjustable | 0.125 | 0.125 | 0.25 |
| Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 0.125 | 0.0 | 0.125 |

## Points of reading

- The two adjustable products amortize over 360 months but hold the note rate fixed for only 60 months (Country Home 5/6 Adjustable) or 84 months (Country Home 7/6 Adjustable); on every fixed product the fixed period equals the amortization.
- The Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed offers no relationship discount (0.0 points), and its discount cap of 0.125 points equals its autopay discount.
- *Hypothetical illustration of the interest convention:* on a principal of 240000.00 USD at an annual rate of 6.0 percent, one month's interest is 240000.00 multiplied by 6.0, divided by 100 and divided by 12, that is 1200.00 USD, whether the month has 28, 30 or 31 days.
